name: Dora
tagline: Dora is an AI-powered no-code website builder that specialises in visually striking sites with 3D elements, smooth animations, and interactive effects — the kind of design work that normally requires a specialist developer. Its AI generates complete page designs from a prompt, and the visual editor gives designers fine control over every interaction. Agencies and product teams use Dora when they need a marketing site that genuinely stands out from template-built competitors.
